commit_note: frozen before any lane branch (no lanes dispatched; A1-direct work only)

query_contract.input_surface: explicit ordered manifest-ID list -> ManifestEntry{manifest_id, absolute path, sha256}; duplicates rejected; no glob/discovery
query_contract.verification: bytes re-hashed and compared to pin BEFORE duckdb sees them; drift => NOT_EVALUABLE(MANIFEST_HASH_DRIFT)
query_contract.sql_surface: single statement over registered views; bound parameters for values; ORDER BY mandatory and must contain frozen order columns
query_contract.forbidden_sql_literals: direct file literals (.csv/.parquet/.json/.duckdb/.jsonl) and absolute-path literals rejected: verified views are the only file surface
query_contract.connection_policy: SET autoinstall_known_extensions=false; SET autoload_known_extensions=false; derived databases opened read_only=True; httpfs never installed/loaded

identity.digest: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact)

output_enforcement.schema: exact column names + canonical duckdb types (aliases: TIMESTAMPTZ == TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE); arity drift => NOT_EVALUABLE
output_enforcement.order: frozen order columns required in ORDER BY; row-order drift changes result_digest
output_enforcement.census: row_count, per-column null census, clock_min/clock_max canonicalized to UTC ISO-8601, result_digest over row bytes

query_contract.evidence_rule: missing manifest / hash drift / malformed db / schema drift => NOT_EVALUABLE with reason; never an empty-success substitution
negative_matrix: query text change after freeze (new identity)
newer file present but not named (invisible)

calendar_contract.package_pin: exchange_calendars version + content digest hashed per install (package_upgrade => digest change => gate blocks)
calendar_contract.official_cross_check_rule: MATCH => PASS; ABSENT => PASS_ABSENT_RECORDED (honest absence); DISAGREEMENT => fail closed at build + BLOCKED_OFFICIAL_DISAGREEMENT at verify
calendar_contract.asset_class_gate: forex and crypto REFUSE equity-calendar routing (EquityRoutingRefused)
calendar_contract.zero_session_ranges: a request range with zero sessions is an honestly-empty manifest, not an error
negative_matrix: package upgrade changes digest and gate blocks
US federal vs exchange holiday differences

telemetry_contract.default: no-op (no SDK configured, no files, zero output); SDK injected only at controller boundary
telemetry_contract.exporter: LOCAL JSONL only (gitignored runtime dir); NO network exporter exists in this contract
telemetry_contract.disable_switch: V3_TELEMETRY_DISABLE=1 makes JSONL behave exactly as no-op; noninterference test proves scientific bytes equal on/off
telemetry_contract.value_redaction: URLs with query secrets => [REDACTED_URL_SECRET]; S1 path fragments (/s1/, s1_sealed, sealed_s1) => [REDACTED_S1_PATH]; >512-char values => [REDACTED_LONG_VALUE]; env-map-shaped payloads (all-caps keys or env/environ names) => [REDACTED_MAP]; >64-element lists => [REDACTED_LIST]; recursion applies at every depth

cads_contract.layout: store_root/objects/<2-hex-prefix>/<sha256> + pins.jsonl + events.jsonl (append-only journals, atomic temp+replace writes)
invariants: corruption => CADSIntegrityError: incident + fail-closed, never auto-fixed
restore refuses a backup whose bytes do not hash to the address
concurrent register of identical bytes converges to one object

authority_contract.state_machine: REGISTERED -> INGESTED -> VERIFIED -> GRANTED | BLOCKED (forward only; retries are new attempt records)
authority_contract.grant_rule: GRANTED requires ALL of PIT=PASS_PIT_EVIDENCED, license=AUTHORIZED, entitlement=AUTHORIZED, >=1 verified CADS pin, canary[own channel]=PASS; anything else => BLOCKED with reason (no partial credit)
authority_contract.default_rule: any series outside the frozen target set stays BLOCKED_DATA (including un-probed channels); additions need a plan amendment
